blog_title: Premium Polo T-Shirt Colors for Bulk Printing — 8 New Shades We Added After Losing a Big Order
caption:
Big order cancelled. Buyer said: 'Only 5 colors? I'm going elsewhere.' 😬

He was right. Print clients want choices. So we developed 8 new premium polo shades — now 15+ colors across 220 GSM. Every shade passes 3 wash tests before launch.

That same buyer came back. Order doubled.

Save this if you're scaling your blank polo lineup 👇
